correctness.rationale: Exact block decomposition of every length-q^k factor of the infinite fixed point is proved from q-uniform images and at least two all-zero aligned blocks between consecutive nonzero blocks; W_{k+1} contains both boundary orientations. Avoidance of 11 and 101 gives explicit formulas for every length-3 frequency from K and the first/last two symbols, and shorter frequencies recover those boundaries. Carefully indexed prefix cuts and reversal realize all five intermediate classes, except the width-four last-weight 00/00 exception; no further labels arise. The standalone checker independently evaluates all eight triple counts on 26 q,k cases. Numerical tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The infinitely parameterized exact order-three complexity resolves a natural higher-order complexity question for all q>=4 at every substitution-block length. It classifies every attainable 3-Abelian signature rather than just computing a sequence, and identifies a structurally sharp isolated q=4 defect in the boundary-and-weight distribution. Published total factor statistics and second-order regularity cannot supply this full class census; the classification provides structural input for arbitrary-length questions.
